Work with us

We take on a small number of commissions at a time. Tell us what you need and roughly when.

What we make

  • Narrative short

    A story with a beginning and an end, usually one to five minutes.

    • Finished film, graded and mixed
    • Master file plus a web-ready export

  • Brand film

    A film for a product or a company that is watchable on its own.

    • Finished film, graded and mixed
    • Cutdowns for social if you need them

  • Animation

    Moving image work that is not shot — sequences, titles, transitions, whole pieces.

    • Finished sequence, graded
    • Master file plus a web-ready export
